# A right from the custom granter's list may take this location's slot: false only when
# it is the last free slot, the specialization draw is on, the location has no
# specialization yet (royal right or 1.4 charter) and the rights map scores one here
# (cm_trmm_best_mil, the draw's own order). Before the draw's advance the slot waits
# too: a granted right is not taken back. Root is the location, scope:cm_country set.

	NOT = {
		AND = {

			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_mil
			var:cm_trmm_best_mil > 0
			cm_perf_town_rights_free > 0
			cm_perf_town_rights_free < 2
